tasks.title: Repository/toolchain bootstrap + CI activation
tasks.goal: Establish the production monorepo workspace, implementation toolchain/runtime choices needed to build/test, and active minimal CI without changing Frozen Product/Architecture semantics.
tasks.validation_scope: Clean bootstrap plus format/lint/typecheck/unit smoke and CI run.
tasks.preferred_executor: Local Builder on real build host + strong-model guidance

tasks.title: Canonical domain contracts, schemas and semantic kernel
tasks.goal: Implement one Core-owned contract/schema layer for AcquisitionContract, SelectionSnapshot, logical identities, scope/continuation, budgets, typed results and shared ports.
tasks.validation_scope: Schema/contract tests, invalid-state rejection and C01-C34 contract-level semantic oracles.

tasks.title: Validation harness, corpora and gate instrumentation
tasks.goal: Create reusable harnesses/corpora for S1-S6, C01-C34, G0/G1, Critical Journeys and exact-subject evidence capture without claiming PASS.
tasks.validation_scope: Harness self-tests, corpus identity/denominator checks and baseline pre-registration enforcement.

tasks.title: Core command/query authority boundary
tasks.goal: Implement versioned local command/query authority with idempotent commands/observations, projections, bounded peer authorization and input validation.
tasks.validation_scope: Contract compatibility, malformed/oversized input rejection, peer authorization and transport restart.

tasks.title: SQLite persistence, durable ledger and recovery
tasks.goal: Implement SQLite + filesystem authoritative persistence, production schema/migrations, stable lineage and deterministic DB/filesystem reconciliation.
tasks.validation_scope: Real SQLite/filesystem process-kill/restart, migrations, DB-first/FS-first reconciliation and digest/provenance.
tasks.preferred_executor: Local Builder on real SQLite/filesystem host

tasks.title: Scheduler, lifecycle budgets, cancellation and retry
tasks.goal: Implement single Core-owned scheduling/budget mutation, durable cancellation-vs-acceptance cutoff, retry/resume and idempotent effect lineage.
tasks.validation_scope: State-machine/property tests for budgets, duplicate clients, cancel timing matrix and retry/resume.

tasks.title: Typed Evidence, Validation, Coverage and Result projection
tasks.goal: Implement typed EvidenceLedger, ValidationRecord, requested-scope CoverageAccounting and deterministic multidimensional ResultProjector.
tasks.validation_scope: Exhaustive status/counterexample projection tests; reject self-certification/count-only/empty-set false success.

tasks.title: Direct HTTP/file acquisition + resume/retry/integrity
tasks.goal: Implement direct HTTP/HTTPS and direct media-file acquisition with stable logical target identity, provenance-bound redirects and safe Range/If-Range behavior.
tasks.validation_scope: Controlled HTTP tests for redirects, validator changes, safe restart, truncation, retries, budgets and wrong-target/integrity failure.

tasks.title: HLS VOD media adapter
tasks.goal: Implement dedicated basic HLS VOD adapter with manifest/rendition binding, segment budget accounting, supported assembly and fail-closed unsupported topology.
tasks.validation_scope: Manifest/rendition/segment/media validation, missing segment, unsupported topology and provenance/budget tests.

tasks.title: Browser observation, Native Messaging broker and scoped authorization
tasks.goal: Implement browser observation plus Native Messaging/local broker with opaque AuthorizationContextRef, exact binding, least authority and secret containment.
tasks.validation_scope: Real-browser task validation plus origin/partition/binding misuse, expiry, allowed_origins and secret-sink negatives.
tasks.preferred_executor: Local Builder with real Chromium/native host

tasks.title: Recipe/discovery engine + bounded collection semantics
tasks.goal: Implement declarative Recipe matching/interpreter, finite capabilities, current_page snapshot semantics, explicit collection continuation, HITL and no arbitrary frontier.
tasks.validation_scope: S5/S6 + C01-C34 collection fixtures including continuation NONE, declared bounds, successor snapshots, loops and frontier rejection.

tasks.title: Bounded AI proposal adapter
tasks.goal: Implement optional provider adapter receiving redacted bounded gaps and emitting schema-constrained Recipe proposals without granting scope/navigation/secret/validation authority.
tasks.validation_scope: Schema/policy rejection, secret redaction, model-offline fallback and malicious proposal tests.

tasks.title: CLI adapter
tasks.goal: Implement first-class CLI submission, batch input and machine-readable status as a thin adapter over shared command/query/result contracts.
tasks.validation_scope: CLI golden/contract tests, non-interactive errors, cancel/retry routing and no private lifecycle authority.

tasks.title: Desktop UI adapter
tasks.goal: Implement primary Desktop UI as thin presentation/interaction adapter for scope preview/confirmation, selection, status, cancellation/retry and result explanation.
tasks.validation_scope: Component/interaction tests for immutable scope, batch confirmation, selection, status explanation and Core authority.

tasks.title: Authoritative Core runtime integration
tasks.goal: Converge command/query, persistence, scheduler, evidence/result and S1/S3/S4 adapters into one authoritative Core Runtime.
tasks.validation_scope: Focused Core integration, process restart, duplicate command, cancellation cutoff, budgets, transfer/media and projection tests.

tasks.title: Browser + collection workflow integration
tasks.goal: Integrate browser/auth and bounded Recipe/collection workflows with authoritative Core for S2/S5/S6 preserving snapshot, authorization and no crawler escape.
tasks.validation_scope: Focused real-browser + fixture S2/S5/S6 flows, expiry, continuation rules, partial/inaccessible members and provenance redirects.
tasks.preferred_executor: High-capability local Builder with browser access

tasks.title: Surface + AI convergence integration
tasks.goal: Wire Desktop, CLI and bounded AI to integrated Core/Browser/Collection while proving one contract/result truth and deterministic paths independent of AI.
tasks.validation_scope: Cross-surface same-contract/status, concurrent UI/CLI, AI-offline fallback, HITL parity and no surface-local authority.

tasks.title: Packaging and platform integration
tasks.goal: Create production build/package integration for selected v0.1.0 runtime/shell/browser tuple(s), including native-host registration and package exclusion of development execution material.
tasks.validation_scope: Production build/package smoke, clean install/launch/native-host registration and package-content audit.
tasks.preferred_executor: Local Builder on selected real platform host(s)

tasks.title: Version candidate preparation + visible regression convergence
tasks.goal: Converge all implementation/package work, run required cheap/full visible regression preconditions and establish one immutable exact candidate for version-level validation.
tasks.validation_scope: Clean bootstrap, configured CI, full unit/contract/integration, S1-S6 harness discovery, package smoke and currentness.

tasks.title: Core crash/restart/data-integrity Validation
tasks.goal: Independently validate exact candidate real SQLite/filesystem crash/restart, recovery, idempotency, budgets, cancellation cutoff and artifact integrity.
tasks.validation_scope: Exact-candidate process-kill/restart, DB/FS reconciliation, duplicate-client, cancel matrix, retry/resume and corruption/missing bytes.
tasks.preferred_executor: Independent Validator on real applicable host

tasks.title: Browser/auth/security real-host Validation
tasks.goal: Independently validate exact candidate browser extension/native broker/auth boundary on concrete claimed tuple(s), including secret containment and fail-closed misuse.
tasks.validation_scope: Real browser/native host, allowed_origins, binding/partition/expiry, secret-sink audit and negative misuse.

tasks.title: Product gates + Critical Journey Validation
tasks.goal: Run S1-S6 Critical Journeys, C01-C34 negatives and required G0/G1 gates, plus G2 only if AI is release-enabled, against pre-registered corpora/baselines.
tasks.validation_scope: Exact-candidate CJ matrix, denominator/UNKNOWN/abandonment truth, baseline integrity, false-success and model-offline regression.

tasks.title: Package/platform qualification Validation
tasks.goal: Validate production build/package/install/launch/native-host registration on each concrete release-claimed platform/browser tuple and record unsupported tuples explicitly.
tasks.validation_scope: Clean install, package integrity, launch, Core reachability, extension/native host wiring, cleanup and package-content audit.
tasks.preferred_executor: Independent Platform Validator on each claimed host

tasks.title: Candidate Freeze gate
tasks.goal: Verify all mandatory visible gates bind one exact candidate and record Candidate Freeze only if currentness/prerequisites hold.
tasks.validation_scope: Evidence/currentness reduction only; no new tests.

tasks.title: Hidden Validation
tasks.goal: Execute authorized hidden/adversarial validation pack against the frozen exact candidate without changing the subject.
tasks.validation_scope: Hidden normal/boundary/negative scenarios bound to frozen candidate.

tasks.title: Version Closure
tasks.goal: Evaluate frozen candidate against mandatory visible Validation, Critical Journeys, Hidden Validation, real platform/production build, limitations and release blockers.
tasks.validation_scope: Evidence identity/currentness/completeness reduction; no substitute testing.

tasks.title: Release Qualification
tasks.goal: Apply ADS Release Qualification to the closed exact candidate and return PASS only when every Frozen mandatory gate passes and no release blocker remains.
tasks.validation_scope: Verify closure, package identities, support matrix, mandatory gates and blockers; no new implementation.

tasks.title: Version PR + release baseline integration
tasks.goal: After Release Qualification PASS only, integrate version/v0.1.0 to main through final Version PR and establish release baseline without changing qualified bytes/semantics.
tasks.validation_scope: Merge-base/currentness, exact candidate ancestry, final diff, post-merge identity and no unqualified delta.
